previous_statement: Lower-modulus dichotomy: for every n>=1, if a_n:=inf_{0!=Z in M_n tensor S_P} ||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)||/||Z||, then a_n^2>=a_n*(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e; consequently a_n<=r_-(e) or a_n>=r_+(e).
new_statement: Lower-modulus dichotomy on the nonzero-corner branch: assume S_P!={0}. Then for every n>=1 the set R_n:={||(Ha^Q_{P,P})_n(Z)||/||Z||:0!=Z in M_n tensor S_P} is nonempty and has a finite nonnegative infimum a_n; this a_n satisfies a_n^2>=a_n*(1-K_sq*e)-C_prod*e and consequently a_n<=r_-(e) or a_n>=r_+(e). If S_P={0}, the root estimate is instead immediate as proved in node 1.2.2.2.1, and no a_n is defined.
